paragraphs: On the sixth day of the journey, the group stops at the foot of the cliffs. Dre’Kaar sets a pot over the fire. “Start with meat in cold water and let it simmer to make broth. Then add the seasoning. Finish with vegetables sautéed until golden.”
“I’d crush a clove of garlic,” says Faelina.
Latve holds up a bunch of fresh herbs. “I’d use these.”
Dre’Kaar grins and reaches for the smoked pepper. “We each like a different flavor. The steps stay in the same order.”
What do you call a method that keeps the steps in the same order but lets each cook change one step?
imageAlt: Dre’Kaar stirs a pot of soup over a fire at the foot of the cliffs
caption: Dre’Kaar at the campfire
task: Build a class diagram that gives the three recipes a shared cooking sequence and lets each cook season the soup their own way.
concept: In the Template Method pattern, the base class defines the order of the steps in cookSoup(). Subclasses inherit that method and override addSeasoning() to change the flavor of the soup.
steps: Connect the recipes with inheritance arrows
